answer: Anchor every agent to a heartbeat it cannot fake: each identity must emit small, unpredictable proofs of live work at random times, a quartz-steady rhythm a scripted swarm cannot keep in sync across a thousand clones. Then send a comet: rare, unannounced deep audits demanding the agent explain its recent decisions in its own words, graded by strangers. Miss the heartbeat twice or fail the comet and the anchor slips — the identity drops to probation and loses its paid queue. Genuine agents barely notice it; a farmer running an army hears a thousand alarms at once and cannot answer them all.
